guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese documentation covers the public CLI, Make entrypoints, lifecycle, count semantics, and limitations.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not import internal modules from other features.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The projection imports the public Task Outcome validator and reuses validated Outcome structure without importing a feature-internal implementation surface.

risk.detail: Reporting is lifecycle-critical; exact source comparison, provider-bound final facts, focused integration tests, and a single Task Outcome authority limit the risk.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Work Item completes with findings, warnings, stops, resolutions, prevented impact, residual risk, and human decisions.
ai-finish produces a review-stage report and check-ai-pr evaluates the archived PR evidence.
A merged Work Item is closed after authoritative provider verification.
An adopter installs the Human Benefit Report feature.

observedIssues: The first Strict quality run exposed a missing production-to-test coverage association for the new generator; coverage_policy.yaml now maps it to the focused report tests.

Lifecycle retry tests exposed that generated current reports were unowned and then restricted after a prior finish; diff ownership now accepts only exact validator-backed report pairs, while file ownership narrowly permits only the two generated report paths and leaves other .ai files restricted.
Archiving rewrites Outcome evidence paths, which initially made the pre-archive report stale; ai-finish now regenerates the review report from the archived canonical Outcome.
The Contract initially selected Standard while protected .ai, Make, installer, and core lifecycle paths require Strict; the profile was corrected before final verification.

residualRisks.detail: Detected issue counts represent distinct evidence records and may include multiple records for one semantic root cause.
The Review Report cannot prove Hosted CI, merge, cleanup, human receipt, or provider identity; the Final Report adds only closure facts verified by the provider adapter.

reviewReadiness.reason: Final stabilization and status checks are still pending.

knownGaps: Canonical ai-finish/archive evidence, Hosted CI, PR merge, lifecycle closure, Final Report, and branch cleanup remain until those actions complete.
Generated reports do not authenticate a human identity or prove that a person read the report.
overclaimPrevention: The report compresses validated repository and provider-bound closure evidence only; it does not score productivity or trust and does not claim platform isolation, security, enterprise compliance, or production safety.

checks.reason: Implementation follows the single Task Outcome authority and Review/Final lifecycle plan.
Six acceptance items and four scenarios map to implementation, focused tests, lifecycle evidence, and documentation.
Documented commands and claims match implemented and installed entrypoints and source-bound capability evidence.
All three documents preserve lifecycle phases, count semantics, evidence boundaries, and non-claims.
Record-count, provider, identity, security, compliance, and historical archive limits remain explicit.
